Addendum No. 1 — Bid LC-ENV-2026-031
Addendum No. 1 modifies the original solicitation.
DEADLINE CHANGE: The electronic bid submission deadline is extended from December 10, 2026 at 3:00 PM
EST to December 17, 2026 at 3:00 PM EST.
INSTALLATION CHANGE: The required completion period is changed from 120 calendar days to 150 calendar
days after notice to proceed.
TECHNICAL CLARIFICATION: DC Fast Chargers may use CCS1 or NACS connectors, provided the proposed
equipment supports the County's adapter and interoperability requirements.
WARRANTY CHANGE: The minimum manufacturer warranty for charging equipment is increased from five years
to six years.
All other requirements remain unchanged unless expressly modified by this addendum.

| Product | Model No. | Part No. | Warranty |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DC Fast Charger | VE-FC150 | VE-150-CCS1 | 5-year equipment warranty |
| Level 2 Charger | VE-L219 | VE-L2-19-2 | 5-year equipment warranty |
| Charging Gateway | VE-GW300 | VE-GW-300 | 3-year hardware warranty |

Fleet Charging Equipment — Technical Specifications
Minimum technical specifications for all proposed equipment.
DC Fast Charger: minimum 150 kW output, CCS1 connector, OCPP 1.6J support, payment terminal capability, and
outdoor-rated enclosure.
Level 2 Charger: minimum 19.2 kW output, J1772 connector, OCPP 1.6J support, Wi-Fi/Ethernet connectivity, and
load balancing.
Charging Management Gateway: minimum 3 Ethernet interfaces, centralized monitoring, remote firmware
management, and role-based access control.
Manufacturer registration is required before commissioning.
Proposed manufacturer: VoltEdge Energy.

Lakeview County — Fleet Charging Infrastructure RFP
Bid Number: LC-ENV-2026-031
Title: Fleet Charging Infrastructure
Issuing Organization: Lakeview County Department of Public Works
Contract term: two years from notice to proceed, with two optional one-year renewals.
Bid bond: 10% of the total proposal price is required.
Payment terms: Net 45 days after receipt and acceptance of a proper invoice.
Installation must be completed within 120 calendar days after notice to proceed.
Required documentation: signed bid form, W-9, manufacturer authorization letter, safety plan, and non-collusion
affidavit.
The bidder must provide a minimum five-year manufacturer's warranty for charging equipment.

Vendor Compliance, Safety and Documentation
Requirements
Bid Number: LC-ENV-2026-031
The proposal must include a signed bid form, W-9, manufacturer authorization letter, site-specific electrical safety
plan, and non-collusion affidavit.
The bidder must identify a qualified project manager and provide evidence of relevant charging-infrastructure
installation experience.
The safety plan must address electrical isolation, site traffic control, and commissioning procedures.
Failure to provide a required document may result in the proposal being deemed non-responsive.
